lines.text: One word. And suddenly you think the relationship is over.
You read, okay. In your head, it sounds like this.
Text gives you words. You add the voice, the face, the entire argument.
In an email study, people overestimated how clearly their tone came across.
So before you turn okay into I hate you, consider her side.
She's eating a sandwich, typing with one greasy finger.
You're planning a breakup. She's asking for napkins.
